```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)

rm(list = ls())

options("scipen" = 100, "digits" = 4)
```

# Sample statistics and observation counts in cohorts
```{r}
years_to_text <- function(x) {
  x <- sort(unique(x))
  runs <- split(x, cumsum(c(1, diff(x) != 1)))
  paste(sapply(runs, function(r) ifelse(length(r) == 1, r, paste(min(r), "-", max(r)))), collapse = ", ")
}

tables <- list()

for (group in c("55_64", "65_74")) {

data_raw <- readRDS(paste0("outputs/lfs_", group, ".rds"))

data <- readRDS(paste0("outputs/sample_", group, ".rds"))

table_all <- data_raw %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(survey_years = years_to_text(year),
            total_observations = n())

table_incl <- data %>%
  mutate(
    missing_status = ifelse(is.na(status), 1, 0),
    missing_hours = ifelse(!is.na(status) & status == "Employed" & is.na(working_hours_usual), 1, 0),
    missing = ifelse(missing_status == 1 | missing_hours == 1, 1, 0)) %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(included_observations = n(),
            included_cohorts = years_to_text(cohort),
            missing = mean(missing) * 100,
            missing_status = mean(missing_status) * 100,
            missing_hours = mean(missing_hours) * 100)

tables[[paste0("sample_stats_", group)]] <- table_all %>% left_join(table_incl, by = "country")

table <- table(data$country, data$cohort_two) %>% as.data.frame() %>% pivot_wider(names_from = Var2, values_from = Freq)

table$Total <- rowSums(table[, -1])

tables[[paste0("cohort_obs_", group)]] <- table %>% rename("country" = "Var1")

}

write.xlsx(tables, "outputs/tables_A3_A6.xlsx")

rm(data_raw, data, table_all, table_incl, table, tables, group)

```

# Prevalence of activity states, working hours and survival by age
```{r, warning = F}
data <- rbind(readRDS("outputs/sample_55_64.rds"), readRDS("outputs/sample_65_74.rds"))

data <- data %>% filter(!is.na(status))

table <- data %>%
  mutate(employed = ifelse(status == "Employed", 1, 0)) %>%
  group_by(country, gender, cohort_two, age) %>%
  summarise(
    employment = weighted.mean(status == "Employed", weight),
    retirement = weighted.mean(status == "Retired", weight),
    unemployment = weighted.mean(status == "Unemployed", weight),
    inactivity = weighted.mean(status %in% c("Ill health", "Other"), weight),
    hours = ifelse(sum(employed) > 0, weighted.mean(working_hours, weight * employed), NA),
    survival = mean(survival, na.rm = T)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(cohort = as.numeric(paste0("19", substr(cohort_two, 2, 3))))

plot_age <- function(table, y, ylab) {

ggplot(table, aes(x = age, y = .data[[y]], group = cohort_two, colour = cohort)) +
  facet_wrap(~ country, ncol = 7) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 64.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_linedraw(base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", colour = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_colour_viridis_c("Birth cohort") +
  scale_x_continuous("Age", breaks = seq(55, 75, 5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(ylab, limits = c(0, 1))

}

vars <- c("employment", "retirement", "unemployment", "inactivity", "hours", "survival")
ylabs <- c("Prevalence of employment", "Prevalence of retirement", "Prevalence of unemployment",
           "Prevalence of inactivity", "Average normalised working hours", "Survival rate")

for (i in 1:length(vars)) {

  p <- plot_age(table %>% filter(gender == "Female population"), vars[i], ylabs[i])
  ggsave(paste0("outputs/figA", 4 + 2 * i, "_", vars[i], "_female.tiff"), p, width = 10, height = 7)

  p <- plot_age(table %>% filter(gender == "Male population"), vars[i], ylabs[i])
  ggsave(paste0("outputs/figA", 5 + 2 * i, "_", vars[i], "_male.tiff"), p, width = 10, height = 7)

}

```
